activity_statements.statement: delivers an average of 22.4 million packages per day (5.7 billion packages in 2024) through an integrated air and ground network serving 200+ countries and territories
provides contract logistics, warehousing, and distribution solutions through the Supply Chain Solutions segment for healthcare, retail, and industrial customers
offers airfreight, ocean freight, and customs brokerage for international shippers
operates RFID-enabled Smart Package Smart Facility technology to optimize network efficiency and provide end-to-end shipment visibility
provides specialized healthcare logistics services including temperature-controlled shipping and clinical trial supply chain management
generated $91.1 billion in total revenue in 2024 through package delivery and logistics operations

name_reality_gap: UPS is classified as 'Freight & Package Transportation' which is largely accurate; however the firm is also a major contract logistics operator (warehousing, distribution) and a healthcare cold-chain specialist — activities that go well beyond the brown-truck package-delivery brand image.
extraction_notes: UPS main website (ups.com) timed out. 10-K accessed via ExaSearch with detailed business description and segment data. Revenue segment weights are estimates based on typical UPS reporting; $91.1B total 2024 revenue confirmed in 10-K.
